title: The Second Bond
summary: The Skeletal Centurion acknowledges Ha-Jun's sovereign lineage, disintegrating into celestial marrow ash as the Bone of the Forgotten permanently fuses into his skeleton, granting skeletal armor plating.

panels.shot: centurion kneeling in silence wide shot
panels.action: The 15-foot Skeletal Centurion remains bowed before 17-year-old Ha-Jun in absolute stillness.
panels.prose_en: The 15-foot Skeletal Centurion remains bowed before 17-year-old Ha-Jun in absolute stillness.
panels.prose_hi: 15 foot ka kankal Centurion purna shanti mein Satra saal ka Ha-Jun ke samne jhuka hua hai.

panels.shot: azure soul flame turning calm violet
panels.action: The furious blue fire in the Centurion's eyes shifts into a serene, tranquil violet resonance.
panels.prose_en: The furious blue fire in the Centurion's eyes shifts into a serene, tranquil violet resonance.
panels.prose_hi: Senturian ki aankhon mein dahakti hui neeli aag ek shant, shaant baingani mana roshni mein badal jaati hai.

panels.action: The Centurion speaks with solemn grace: 'Thousands of years I have guarded this marrow for the true blood.'

dialogue.speaker: centurion
dialogue.text: Hazaaron saalon se maine is marrow ki hifazat ki... Aaj mera pehra khatam hua.

panels.prose_en: The Centurion speaks with solemn grace: 'Thousands of years I have guarded this marrow for the true blood.'.
panels.prose_hi: Senturian gambhir anugrah ke saath bolta hai: 'hajaron varshon se maine sacche khoon ke liye is majja ki raksha ki hai.'

panels.shot: centurion body dissolving into luminescent ash
panels.action: The colossal skeletal titan begins dissolving into swirling ribbons of golden-white luminescent dust.
panels.prose_en: The colossal skeletal titan begins dissolving into swirling ribbons of golden-white luminescent dust.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal kankal titan sunahre-safed chamakdar dhul ke ghumte hue ribbon mein ghulna shuru kar deta hai.

panels.shot: golden ash ascending to cavern ceiling
panels.action: Millions of glowing particles drift upward like reverse snow, illuminating the dark limestone vaults.
panels.prose_en: Millions of glowing particles drift upward like reverse snow, illuminating the dark limestone vaults.
panels.prose_hi: Lakhon chamakte kan ulti barf ki tarah upar ki or bahte han, jo gahre chuna patthar ke tahkhanon ko roshan karte han.

panels.shot: the bone of the forgotten floating down
panels.action: From the altar, the 14-inch curved ivory bone relic drifts gently down toward Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_en: From the altar, the 14-inch curved ivory bone relic drifts gently down toward Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Vedi se, 14 inch ki ghumavdar hathi daant ki haddi ka avashesh dhire-dhire Ha-Jun ki chhati ki or badhta hai.

panels.action: Kuro lowers his wings in quiet respect: 'Farewell, General Vaelor. Tumhara duty pura hua.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: General Vaelor... Sovereign ka sabse wafadar senapati.

panels.prose_en: Kuro lowers his wings in quiet respect: 'Farewell, General Vaelor. Tumhara duty pura hua.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne shant samman mein apne pankh neeche kar die: 'vidai, general velor. tumhara kartavya pura hua.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his left bare forearm as the Bone of the Forgotten hovers within inches of his skin.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun extends his left bare forearm as the Bone of the Forgotten hovers within inches of his skin.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni bayin nangi baanh ko failata hai kyonki bhuli hui haddi uski tvacha ke inch ke bhitar ghumti hai.

panels.action: The moment the ivory relic touches Ha-Jun's wrist, it liquefies into pure molten white calcium light.
panels.prose_en: The moment the ivory relic touches Ha-Jun's wrist, it liquefies into pure molten white calcium light.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi hathi daant ka avashesh Ha-Jun ki kalai ko chhuta hai, yah shuddh pighle hue safed calcium prakash mein pighal jata hai.

panels.shot: molten bone sinking into ha-jun flesh
panels.action: The white light sinks directly beneath his epidermis, wrapping tightly around his radius and ulna bones.
panels.prose_en: The white light sinks directly beneath his epidermis, wrapping tightly around his radius and ulna bones.
panels.prose_hi: Safed prakash sidhe uski bahya tvacha ke neeche doob jata hai, uski trijya aur alna haddiyon ke charon or kaskar lapet jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun gripping arm in silent endurance
panels.action: Ha-Jun grits his teeth; his skeleton emits a dull ceramic chime as bone density multiplies.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Dard nahi hai... Yeh toh ek warm, solid support jaisa lag raha hai!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grits his teeth; his skeleton emits a dull ceramic chime as bone density multiplies.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne dant pista hai; jaise hi haddi ka ghanatv kai guna badh jata hai, uska kankal ek dhimi siremik jhankar ka utsarjan karta hai.

panels.action: Along his left forearm, an intricate segmented gauntlet of polished white bone and crimson runes emerges.
panels.prose_en: Along his left forearm, an intricate segmented gauntlet of polished white bone and crimson runes emerges.
panels.prose_hi: Uski bayin baanh ke sath, polish ki hui safed haddi aur lal rang ki runs ka ek jatil khandit gauntlet ubharta hai.

panels.action: Sharp, razor-honed ivory spurs extend over his knuckles, ready to deliver lethal blunt force.
panels.prose_en: Sharp, razor-honed ivory spurs extend over his knuckles, ready to deliver lethal blunt force.
panels.prose_hi: Tej, ustra-dharit hathidant spers uske por par faile hue han, jo ghatak kund bal dene ke liye taiyar han.

panels.action: A brilliant shockwave of bone-white and violet mana bursts outward, blowing away all lingering dust.
panels.prose_en: A brilliant shockwave of bone-white and violet mana bursts outward, blowing away all lingering dust.
panels.prose_hi: Haddi-safed aur baingani man ki ek shandar shockwev bahar ki or footati hai, jo sabhi bachi hui dhul ko uda deti hai.

panels.action: Golden system banners unfurl across the air with celebratory demonic crests.

dialogue.text:
[RELIC BONDED: BONE OF THE FORGOTTEN (BASIC)]
Synchronization Rate: 32.4% (Threshold Broken!)
New Ability: Skeletal Armor & Bone Spikes
Passive: Skeletal Durability increased by +400%.

panels.prose_en: Golden system banners unfurl across the air with celebratory demonic crests.
panels.prose_hi: Swarnim pranali ke banner jashn manane wali shaitani demonic shikhaon ke saath hawa mein lahrate han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun flexes his left hand; the bone gauntlet moves with fluid biomechanical grace like second skin.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh armor... bilkul natural feel hota hai. Mere muscle ka hissa lagta hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flexes his left hand; the bone gauntlet moves with fluid biomechanical grace like second skin.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apna bayan haath moda; haddi ka gauntlet dusri tvacha ki tarah taral biomacanikal anugrah ke saath chalta hai.

panels.action: Kuro taps the bone plating with his beak: 'Solid. Ab Hunter ki ordinary bullets tumhara haath nahi cheer sakti.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Armor-piercing rounds bhi is bone plate par deflect ho jayengi.

panels.prose_en: Kuro taps the bone plating with his beak: 'Solid. Ab Hunter ki ordinary bullets tumhara haath nahi cheer sakti.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apni chonch se haddi ki parat ko thapthapata hai: 'thos. ab hunter ki sadharan goliyan tumhare haath nahin chilla sakti.'.

panels.shot: ha-jun testing punch on stone pillar
panels.action: Ha-Jun throws a casual punch at the solid limestone wall beside him.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun throws a casual punch at the solid limestone wall beside him.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne bagal ki thos chuna patthar ki deewar par ek aakasmik mukka maarta hai.

panels.action: The solid rock shatters into a six-foot crater instantly, leaving Ha-Jun's bone knuckles completely unscathed.
panels.prose_en: The solid rock shatters into a six-foot crater instantly, leaving Ha-Jun's bone knuckles completely unscathed.
panels.prose_hi: Thos chattan turant chhah foot ke gaddhe mein toot jaati hai, jisse Ha-Jun ki haddi ke por puri tarah se surakshit ho jaate han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun laughs softly in disbelief at the sheer effortless kinetic force.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bina kisi recoil ke... Rock powder ban gayi!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun laughs softly in disbelief at the sheer effortless kinetic force.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sarasar sahaj gatij bal par avishvas karte hue dheere se hansta hai.

panels.shot: sudden heat rising from floor fissures
panels.action: Thin cracks in the cavern floor begin glowing with intense orange-crimson thermal light; sulfur fumes rise.
panels.prose_en: Thin cracks in the cavern floor begin glowing with intense orange-crimson thermal light; sulfur fumes rise.
panels.prose_hi: Gufa ke farsh mein patli dararen tivra naarangi-lal rang ki tapiya roshni se chamakne lagti han; gandhak ka dhuan uthta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun wipes sudden sweat from his brow as the air temperature spikes by 20 degrees Celsius.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Achanak itni garmi kahan se aayi...?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun wipes sudden sweat from his brow as the air temperature spikes by 20 degrees Celsius.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi hawa ka taapmaan 20 degree celsius badh jata hai, Ha-Jun apne mathe se achanak pasina ponchta hai.

panels.action: Kuro's feathers ruffle: 'Yeh third basic relic ka resonance hai! The Ashen Heart!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Do basic relics bond hone se teesra relic apne aap trigger ho gaya hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's feathers ruffle: 'Yeh third basic relic ka resonance hai! The Ashen Heart!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ke pankh fadfadate han: 'ye teesre mool avashesh ki pratidhvani hai! ation hart!'.

panels.action: The Sovereign Interface updates with glowing crimson-orange fire borders.

dialogue.text:
[QUEST CHAIN: THE TRI-SEAL FINAL STEP]
Locate Relic #3: The Ashen Heart.
Coordinates: Bukhansan Magma Fissure (Depth: -1,200m).
Time Remaining: 3 Hours.

panels.prose_en: The Sovereign Interface updates with glowing crimson-orange fire borders.
panels.prose_hi: Soweren interface chamakdar lal-naarangi agni seemaon ke saath adyatan hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up toward chasm exit
panels.action: High above, the faint grey light of dawn begins to peek through the chasm opening.
panels.prose_en: High above, the faint grey light of dawn begins to peek through the chasm opening.
panels.prose_hi: Upar, bhor ki dhundhli dhusar roshni khai ke chhed se jhankane lagti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun aims Min-Jae's flare gun upward and pulls the trigger; a brilliant crimson flare rockets into the sky.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun aims Min-Jae's flare gun upward and pulls the trigger; a brilliant crimson flare rockets into the sky.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne min-je ki bhadkili bandook ko upar ki or nishana banaya aur trigger khinch liya; aasman mein ek shandar lal rang ki chamak wale rocket.

panels.action: The red phosphorus flare illuminates the quarry mist like a miniature sunrise above the parked van.
panels.prose_en: The red phosphorus flare illuminates the quarry mist like a miniature sunrise above the parked van.
panels.prose_hi: Lal phosphorus ki chamak khadan ki dhundh ko khadi van ke upar ek laghu suryoday ki tarah roshan karti hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae sees the flare, slamming his laptop shut with a proud grin: 'Usne kar dikhaya!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: He did it! Van ready hai, Ha-Jun!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae sees the flare, slamming his laptop shut with a proud grin: 'Usne kar dikhaya!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne aag bhadakte hue dekha aur garv bhari muskan ke saath apna laptop band kar diya: 'usne kar dikhaya!'

panels.shot: ha-jun scaling chasm with bone claws
panels.action: Using his bone-armored fingers like climbing spikes, Ha-Jun rapidly scales the sheer limestone cliff in seconds.
panels.prose_en: Using his bone-armored fingers like climbing spikes, Ha-Jun rapidly scales the sheer limestone cliff in seconds.
panels.prose_hi: Apni haddi-baktarband ungaliyon ka upyog spikes par chadhne ki tarah karte hue, Ha-Jun teji se secondon mein khadi chuna patthar ki chattan par chadh jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands on the cliff rim as morning sunlight breaks over Seoul, his bone gauntlet gleaming like marble.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bukhansan chalo. Aakhri Basic Relic ko humein aaj hi claim karna hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands on the cliff rim as morning sunlight breaks over Seoul, his bone gauntlet gleaming like marble.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi subah ki dhoop seoul par padti hai, Ha-Jun chattan ke kinare par khada hota hai, uski haddi ka kavach sangmarmar ki tarah chamak raha hota hai.
